confidence_notes: FX is the RBA observation for 18 Nov 2026 found via search. I ran one search on Lima food and drink prices. It returned mixed crowd-sourced and aggregator figures, and some of them looked inconsistent or came from very small samples. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass prices were not found directly, so I set them relative to beer and typical Miraflores/Barranco restaurant pricing. I did not search for accommodation. Those anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Lima's tourist districts (Miraflores/Barranco) and on the Andean/Latin American cities most similar to it, such as Bogota and Quito, with some weight on the aggregator figures found.
